note: best-known fidelity score per route; written by check-visual-budget.mjs --update Entries re-measured 2026-09-16 by 'docs-chrome: demo styling': the component widget parity rose on every route that had one to raise (button 84.42 -> 100, toggle 94.66 -> 100, otp-field 93.84 -> 100, field 87.8 -> 98.79, form 86.99 -> 97.33, fieldset 86.6 -> 96.79, collapsible 88.5 -> 93.35, accordion 89.1 -> 90.01) and became MEASURABLE for the first time on checkbox, meter and checkbox-group (100 each; those three regions were reported as faults before, because the demos' controls were full-width blocks). formula: blended: 0.6 * visual proximity (1 - pixelDiff%) + 0.4 * mean(headings, demos, codeBlocks, snippetPurity, tables, links, textLen) — snippetPurity was added by 3873d8a3e, so entries recorded before it are NOT comparable with measurements taken after it (see each entry's note and ralph/logs/visual/baseline-rebake-20260915.md)

react/components/accordion.note: Re-measured 2026-09-16 by 'docs-content: components/accordion (prose + snippet completion)': page 65.99 -> 87.48 (visual 93.36 -> 93.33 / content 24.93 -> 78.70), pixel diff 6.57% -> 6.67%; component widget unchanged at 90.01% (still below the 97% bar and still a P0 finding, owned by the component's own markup, not by this item). This item is what moved it: the `## API reference` section was prose (upstream renders 6 generated tables / 24 rows; the page rendered 0), so the generated `types.md` content is now carried as data (`crates/docs-app/src/pages/accordion_reference.rs`) and rendered through the ported reference primitives — the five parts' summary lines, props tables (12/6/3/4/5 rows), data-attributes tables (2/3/3/2/6 rows), Accordion.Panel's CSS-variables table, and the 15 `Additional Types` panels with their five `Re-Export of ...` lines. Copy coverage measured by `check-copy-fidelity.mjs` went 22.2% -> 100% (63/63 matched, 0 changed, 0 missing); page text 3982 -> 11564 chars vs upstream's 23911. The page's one embedded snippet was translated from upstream's JSX to the port's own `view!` markup over `leptos_ui`'s parts, so the gap report's `code snippets show React source` P0 is gone and its snippet counter reads leptos/react/other 1/0/0. The snippet-language probe itself was fixed at the root in the same item: its JSX-tag heuristic scored an idiomatic Leptos `#[component]` composition as React, and per ralph/logs/spec-discrepancies.md ('a false `react` count must not be fixed by avoiding idiomatic Leptos') the classifier gained a Leptos-exclusive marker rule in both probe copies and its Rust mirror. Remaining P1/P2 gaps on this route (code blocks 1 vs upstream's 45, syntax tokens, demo file tabs, page affordances, `<code>` typography) are other items' scope and are listed in the route's own gap report.
